description: Verify an overtime paycheck's garnishment withholding in four recompute stages: first compute the FLSA regular rate and overtime premium per 29 CFR 778, Subpart C, including nondiscretionary-bonus reallocation (ART-340), then compute federal income tax withholding by the IRS Publication 15-T percentage method for the declared tax year edition (ART-338), then compute gross-to-net pay with FICA at that year's Social Security wage base (ART-339), then recompute how much of the employee's disposable earnings each order in a caller-declared garnishment stack may lawfully withhold under the CCPA Title III caps, compared against a garnishment notice where one is supplied (ART-572), closing with a session receipt aggregating the run's execution hashes (CRY-05). Disposable earnings for the art-572 run are gross earnings minus legally-required deductions, using the gross and legally-required-deduction figures cited from the art-339 run; net pay is never an input to the art-572 run. The aggregate ceiling in the art-572 run, equal to the single highest individual cap present in the stack, is a documented simplification in that run's not_proven list. Wage, filing, deduction, and order figures are caller-supplied inputs; each stage is an independent recompute from its own declared inputs. A mismatch is an arithmetic finding, never a legal determination about an order's validity. Not legal advice and not tax advice.
name: overtime-paycheck-garnishment-check

steps.handoff: Computes the FLSA regular rate of pay and overtime premium per 29 CFR 778, Subpart C, including nondiscretionary-bonus reallocation into the regular rate (778.110, 778.208-778.209) and the 0.5x overtime premium for hours over 40 in the workweek (778.107); federal only, and multi-workweek bonus proration is the caller's responsibility

Computes federal income tax withholding by the IRS Publication 15-T percentage method, Worksheet 1A, for a 2020-or-later Form W-4; tax_year is a required input and selects the edition, and an unsupported year fails closed rather than defaulting

Computes gross-to-net pay: FICA (Social Security 6.2 percent up to the selected tax year's OASDI wage base, Medicare 1.45 percent uncapped, Additional Medicare Tax 0.9 percent over the statutory threshold), pretax deduction ordering, and net pay; its gross and legally-required-deduction figures are the figures cited for the art-572 run, and net pay is not an art-572 input

Recomputes, for one stated pay period, how much of an employee's disposable earnings each order in a caller-declared garnishment stack may lawfully withhold under the CCPA Title III caps, and compares the recomputed per-order withholding against a garnishment notice where one is supplied; disposable earnings for this run are gross earnings minus legally-required deductions, using the gross and legally-required-deduction figures cited from the art-339 run, and net pay is never an input to this run
Produces session_receipt_root, the Merkle root over the run's execution_hashes (final stage)

title: Overtime Paycheck Garnishment Check
